purpose: Document local registry evidence, language-specific searches and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: Krasnoyarsk City’s Department of Municipal Property and Land Relations officially maintains municipal land/property information systems and commissions cadastral work on city land; the city also identifies Roskadastr’s Krasnoyarsk Krai branch as an EGRN source. This establishes local municipal and regional custodians, but not an anonymous city parcel-vector feed. No public city parcel vector schema or geometry response verified; the national NSPD public cadastral map was not treated as city-specific vector evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city department functions include cadastral work and maintaining city land/property accounting databases and municipal-property register.
City IT inventory identifies a Unified Municipal Cadastre information system with real-estate and land-plot accounting data.
City page describes the Krasnoyarsk Krai Roskadastr branch as providing EGRN and land-management records.
Krasnoyarsk Krai geospatial portal provides thematic map layers, but no city parcel-feature schema was verified.
